plain: A longtime UFO researcher named Grant Cameron says that one second after midnight on January 20, he filed 47 requests under FOIA, a US law that lets anyone ask for government records, all at once. He tells podcast host Jesse Michels that the requests were aimed at records about whether Reince Priebus, a White House official, was briefed on UFOs. If such records exist, they would show UFOs being discussed at the top of government.
